manifest.title_fil: Iugnay sa agarang tulong ang may pananakit ng dibdib
objectives_fil: Gamitin ang agarang referral at iulat ang simula at sintomas nang hindi nagrereseta ng aspirin.
objectives_en: Activate the urgent pathway and hand over onset and symptoms without prescribing aspirin.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: May bagong paninikip ng dibdib at namumutla ang adult
sections.takeaway_en: Case: An adult has new chest pressure and looks pale

sections.takeaway_fil: Gamitin ang agarang referral at iulat ang simula at sintomas nang hindi nagrereseta ng aspirin.
sections.takeaway_en: Activate the urgent pathway and hand over onset and symptoms without prescribing aspirin.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tumawag muna ng agarang medikal na tulong.
sections.takeaway_en: Call for urgent medical help before anything else.

check.prompt_fil: Iniaabot ng kapitbahay ang tablet niya. Ano ang unang tugon?
check.prompt_en: The neighbor holds out her tablets. What comes first?

options.fil: Ibigay ang isang tablet ng kapitbahay.
options.en: Give one of the neighbor's tablets.

options.fil: Tumawag agad ng medikal na tulong.
Maghanap muna ng aspirin, saka tumawag.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag magbigay ng gamot ng iba. Ayon sa lokal na protocol at kwalipikadong payo ang gamot. 2: Tama. Humingi muna ng agarang medikal na tulong at pagpahingahin ang tao. 3: Huwag ipagpaliban ang tawag para maghanap ng gamot. Tumawag muna.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not give another person's tablets. Medicine follows local protocol and qualified advice. 2: Correct. Activate urgent assessment first and keep the person at rest. 3: Do not delay the call to find medication. Call first.

sections.takeaway_fil: Agad tumatawag si Lea, iniuulat ang simula at sintomas, at tinatanggihan ang tablet ng kapitbahay.
sections.takeaway_en: Lea calls at once, reports onset and symptoms, and declines the neighbor's tablets.

sections.takeaway_fil: Walang aspirin schedule, walang gamot ng iba, walang pagpapaliban ng tawag.
sections.takeaway_en: No aspirin schedule, no one else's tablets, no delaying the call.

sections.takeaway_fil: Iulat ang simula, sintomas at alam na gamot o allergy.
sections.takeaway_en: Report onset, symptoms and known medicines or allergies.

check.prompt_fil: Sa practice na tawag, ano ang dapat mong iulat?
check.prompt_en: On the practice call, what should you report?

options.fil: Kailan nagsimula ang paninikip, at ang sintomas.
options.en: When the pressure began, and the symptoms.

options.fil: Ang sarili mong hula kung ano ang sanhi ng sakit.
options.en: Your own guess about what is causing it.

options.fil: Ang dosis ng aspirin na balak mong ibigay.
options.en: The aspirin dose that you are planning to give.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama. Iulat ang simula, sintomas at alam na gamot o allergy. 2: Iulat ang nakikita, hindi ang hula sa sanhi. Hindi batayan ng diagnosis ang kuwento. 3: Huwag magreseta ng aspirin. Ayon sa lokal na protocol at kwalipikadong payo ang gamot.
check.feedback_en: 1: Correct. Report onset, symptoms and known medicines or allergies. 2: Report what you see, not a guessed cause. The story is not grounds for a diagnosis. 3: Do not prescribe aspirin. Medicine follows local protocol and qualified advice.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sanayin ang agarang tawag at pag-uulat nang hindi nagrereseta.
sections.takeaway_en: Practise the urgent call and handover without prescribing.
